issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'εως ποτε' (until when) is a question/exclamation of frustration, but the Vietnamese translation 'cho đến chừng nào' functions as a temporal limit for the preceding statement ('ta sẽ ở với các ngươi... cho đến chừng nào'), which changes the grammatical structure and meaning from a rhetorical question to a duration of time.
